# Formatter support

Confirm the document language is **WKT (Coordinate Reference System)** and that the selected formatter is **WKT CRS Formatter**. For JSON snippets, select one quoted value, not its property name. Test with a simple synthetic CRS in an untitled editor.

Open a formatter diagnostic issue for command or coloring problems. Include VS Code and extension versions, the theme, language mode, selection, and observed result. Use a bug report for other defects and a feature request for proposed behavior. For sensitive issues follow [the security policy](../SECURITY.md).
